title: The Brothers Return with Benjamin

questions.question: Why did the brothers have to return to Egypt?
options: The famine was severe and they needed more grain
questions.correctAnswer: The famine was severe and they needed more grain
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:1-2: "Now the famine was severe in the land." Jacob told them to go buy more food.

questions.question: Who pledged to guarantee Benjamin's safety?
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:9: "I will be a pledge of his safety. From my hand you shall require him."

questions.question: Did Jacob eventually let Benjamin go?
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:13-14: Jacob finally agreed and sent Benjamin with his brothers.

questions.question: What did Joseph do when he saw Benjamin?
options: He hurried out to weep privately
questions.correctAnswer: He hurried out to weep privately
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:30: "Joseph hurried out, for his compassion grew warm for his brother, and he sought a place to weep."

questions.question: Were the brothers invited to eat at Joseph's house?
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:16: Joseph told his steward, "Bring the men to my house, and slaughter an animal and make ready."

questions.question: What gifts did Jacob send to the man in Egypt?
options: Balm, honey, gum, myrrh, pistachio nuts, and almonds
questions.correctAnswer: Balm, honey, gum, myrrh, pistachio nuts, and almonds
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:11: "Take some of the choice fruits of the land...balm and honey, gum, myrrh, pistachio nuts, and almonds."

questions.question: What did the brothers fear when brought to Joseph's house?
options: Being enslaved because of the money returned in their sacks
questions.correctAnswer: Being enslaved because of the money returned in their sacks
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:18: "They were afraid because they were brought to Joseph's house...because of the money."

questions.question: What did the steward say about the money in their sacks?
options: He said their God must have put treasure in their sacks
questions.correctAnswer: He said their God must have put treasure in their sacks
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:23: "Your God and the God of your father has put treasure in your sacks."

questions.question: How were the brothers seated at the meal?
options: In order of their birth, from firstborn to youngest
questions.correctAnswer: In order of their birth, from firstborn to youngest
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:33: "The men looked at one another in amazement" because they were seated in birth order.

questions.question: How much more food did Benjamin receive compared to his brothers?
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:34: "Portions were taken to them from Joseph's table, but Benjamin's portion was five times as much."

questions.question: What did Jacob instruct about the money?
options: Take double the money and return the first amount
questions.correctAnswer: Take double the money and return the first amount
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:12: "Take double the money with you. Carry back with you the money that was returned."

questions.question: What did Joseph ask about when he saw his brothers?
options: Whether their father was still alive
questions.correctAnswer: Whether their father was still alive
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:27: "He asked them about their welfare and said, 'Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he still alive?'"

questions.question: Why did Joseph eat separately from the Egyptians and his brothers?
options: Egyptians could not eat with Hebrews as it was an abomination
questions.correctAnswer: Egyptians could not eat with Hebrews as it was an abomination
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:32: "The Egyptians could not eat with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians."

questions.question: What did Joseph say when he blessed Benjamin?
options: God be gracious to you, my son
questions.correctAnswer: God be gracious to you, my son
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:29: "He said, 'God be gracious to you, my son!'"

questions.question: What was the brothers' condition at the end of the meal?
options: They drank and were merry with him
questions.correctAnswer: They drank and were merry with him
questions.explanation: Genesis 43:34: "So they drank and were merry with him."

key_verse_text: Joseph hurried out, for his compassion grew warm for his brother, and he sought a place to weep.
